newsitem.title: USA: Payless ShoeSource to expand into Canada.
newsitem.headline: Payless ShoeSource to expand into Canada.

text.p: Payless ShoeSource Inc. said Monday it plans to expand into Canada by the end of the year and will open five stores in the Toronto area.
Mike Thompson, vice president of retail operations, will manage the Canadian operations, which will offer dress, casual, athletic and speciality shoes, the company said.

Also on Monday, Payless reported net income of $46.1 million, or $1.18 a share, for the second quarter, compared with year-earlier earnings of $40.3 million, or $1.00 a share, before spinoff costs a year ago.
Payless' stock was up 87.5 cents at $56.875 on the New York Stock Exchange.
